pose.protocol: Seed 42 predicts mean delta-U of seeds 43 and 44; models use the same cells and outcome, with 5-fold target-grouped CV. Conditional on all three draws having measured utility. First-draw features represent each cell.

all_probe_roles_pooled.note: All three choices of probe per cell are pooled, not three independent cells. Each cell repeats its seed-42 feature vector in target-grouped CV.
